name: Jarrett Goodwin
headline: Chemical Engineering & Computing Technology (Dual Degree) Graduate: Process Optimization, Data & Automation
summary: University of Ottawa graduate (April 2026) with a dual degree in Chemical Engineering and Computing Technology, including an exchange semester at Florida International University, now pursuing P.Eng licensure through PEO. Engineering co-op experience across pulp and paper (RYAM), food manufacturing (Frito-Lay, two terms), and construction (EllisDon), covering process engineering, automation rollouts, resource conservation, and field supervision. Founder of Current Automations, an AI and process-automation company serving trades and service businesses in Ontario. Strong in data analysis and software (Python, Java, Excel/VBA, machine learning) and bilingual in English and French.

bullets.text: Build and deploy AI and process-automation systems for trades and service businesses, integrating CRMs, phone systems, and AI assistants.
Work directly with owners to map current processes, design reliable workflows, then test, monitor, iterate, and document them so non-technical staff can operate them.
Run the business solo end to end: outreach, discovery, scoping, implementation, and ongoing support.

Oversaw system upgrades and line improvements, coordinating cross-functional implementation.
